facts.fact: Google's help documentation lets a service-area business set up to 20 service areas using cities, postal codes, or other areas it serves.
facts.quote: it lets you set up to **20 service areas** using cities, postal codes, or other areas you serve

facts.fact: Google's help documentation defines a service-area business as one that visits or delivers to customers directly rather than serving them at a public storefront.
facts.quote: Google’s own help documentation defines a service-area business as one that visits or delivers to customers directly rather than serving them at a public storefront

facts.fact: The Adwave guide 'Service Area Business Google Profile Setup Guide' was published on 2026-09-12.
Independent 2025 coverage reports that Google updated the rules to explicitly ban countries and states as service areas on Business Profiles.
facts.quote: Independent 2025 coverage reports that Google updated the rules to explicitly ban **countries and states** as service areas

facts.fact: According to PPC Land's coverage of the 2025 rule update, Google limits service area businesses to boundaries within about two hours of driving time from the base location.
facts.quote: limiting businesses to boundaries within about **two hours of driving time** from the base location

facts.fact: According to PPC Land's coverage of the 2025 rule update, Google allows up to 20 service areas total on a service area business profile.
facts.quote: and up to **20 service areas total**

facts.fact: The vendor recommends that most local operators run a monthly check of their service-area profile.
facts.quote: A monthly check is usually enough for most local operators.
